name: Old Man Logan

abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.

abilitySections.title: 100% Chance every 20 seconds.
content: Old Man Logan gains a Regeneration Buff which heals [4,473.3] Health over 20 seconds. While this Regeneration Buff is active, incoming Bleed effects gain +50% duration but suffer -95% Potency, giving Logan more time to deal with them.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: You can't teach an old, stubborn dog new tricks. Logan's Ability Accuracy cannot be decreased or increased.

abilitySections.title: While Not Fighting Tech Champions
content: Logan gains +[562.5] base Critical Resistance and his Special Attack 3 ignores Armor Rating.

abilitySections.title: Landing Attacks, Blocking Attacks & Being Struck
content: Logan has a 75% chance to gain a Passive Bleed, lasting 5 seconds which deals 0 damage. Max: 15 Stacks.

abilitySections.title: Opponent Purifies a Bleed
content: Logan's deep-cutting Adamantium causes the opponent to instantly take [2,685] direct damage for each Bleed they Purified.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: First hit has a 100% chance to Refresh the duration of Logan's 0 damage Passive Bleed effects.
Second hit has a 100% chance to Pause the duration of all active Fury Buffs for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Logan removes all Regeneration Buffs and Bleed effects from himself, gaining 1 Fury Buff for each effect removed this way. These Buffs last 12 seconds and grant +[465.4] Attack. Max Stacks: 15.
Special Attacks are Unblockable if Logan has 5 or more Fury Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by [750] for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 80% chance per strike to inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [2,506] direct damage over 5 seconds.
Each Critical Hit also has a 80% chance to inflict a Critical Bleed, lasting 5 seconds and dealing [2,506] damage, multiplied by Logan's Critical Damage Multiplier.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a Deep Bleed Debuff which counts as a Bleed effect, lasting 35 seconds and dealing [5,370] direct damage.
If Logan has 5 or more Fury Buffs, inflict an additional Deep Bleed.
While Deep Bleed is active, Logan's attacks gain +[750] Critical Rating and ignore Physical Resistance.
Gain 100% Armor Penetration in this attack. No effect against Tech Champions.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Old Scars
content: Whenever Logan gains one of his 0 Damage Passive Bleeds, it has a [26 - 61.7]% chance to gain +400% duration.
Logan's first Special Attack each fight gains +[1,825.8 - 3,580.01] Attack rating.
